subject.title: chore(deps-dev): bump the development-minor-and-patch group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should this grouped dependency update proceed with the Socket obfuscated-code alerts for `@emnapi/runtime` and `@react-email/ui`, or should the flagged updates be split/held?
rationale: The formatter fix is mechanical, but accepting obfuscated-code warnings in build/dev dependencies is a supply-chain policy choice automation should not make.

options.title: Hold for security triage
options.body: Fix the formatter output, then merge only after a maintainer reviews and accepts or resolves the Socket alerts.

options.title: Split flagged updates
options.body: Keep safe patch updates moving while removing or separately reviewing the Vite/React Email changes that introduce the alerts.

options.title: Accept documented risk
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the Socket warnings and proceed after the formatting blocker is fixed.

recommendation.title: Hold for security triage
recommendation.body: Fix the formatter output, then merge only after a maintainer reviews and accepts or resolves the Socket alerts.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick owns the current package/tooling baseline and merged the CI/static-gate setup that this PR exercises.
